decided_by.description: The rung and engines that decided it.

notes.description: Abstention reasons, when a rung abstained; and (mununu#1175) each l2s member whose lasso the concrete simulator did not confirm, on a `"violated"` row.

size.description: Number of literals in the set.

detail.description: Longer explanation (the why + the soundness/scope implication).

property.description:
mununu#548 O-2 — the property this note is ABOUT, when it is about one.

Absent for a model-level note (reset-gating, control-slice, parameter overrides): those describe the lift, not a property.

**Group notes by this, not by parsing `summary`.** The name used to appear only as a `"<name>: "` prefix inside the prose, so a consumer joining on it inherited two bugs: a property whose name prefixes another's (`sva_1` vs `sva_10`) matched the wrong note, and any rewording of the note's opening silently broke the join.

converted_from_aiger.description: With `justice`: whether the content was ASCII AIGER lowered to BTOR2.

decided_by.description: Portfolio engines that decided the reduced `bad`-reachability query.

justice.description: With `justice`: one entry per justice line (`decided_by` above is empty then).

lift_notes.description: On the `sv` routes: what the lift decided besides the model (mununu#1181, mununu#1189), as typed notes — `clock-domains-merged` and one note per clock with no driver the model can follow, when `lift.merge_clock_domains` accepted them; `blackbox-cut` for the modules with no body, whose outputs are free; `control-slice` for the cut points requested; `parameter-override` for the parameters set; `flop-stub` for a flop primitive the lift supplied a model for; `lift-retry` when the lift ran its script twice. Each says what it means for this result. Empty — and omitted — when the lift made none of these decisions, and on the `btor2` routes, which lift nothing.

notes.description: Track V (V2) — why an UNDECIDED row is undecided: each portfolio member's refusal or budget abstention (`"<member> refused: …"` / `"<member>: …"`), and the k-liveness fallback's note. mununu#1175 — and, on any row, each member whose path the concrete simulator did not confirm (`"<member>: the path it found was not confirmed on the concrete simulator (…)"`), saying whether the result rests on that member alone. Empty — and omitted — otherwise.

property.description: The reduced property, echoed for provenance: `AG((<request>) -> AF (<grant>))`.
